configured_environment: Same fixed Ghidra 12.1.4 archive, JDK, and main ELF bytes; original default auto-analysis configuration is source-supported. Its entire 146-option snapshot was not directly sampled.
field_policy: Every leaf including empty arrays/objects of both mapped documents is accounted for. Explicit many-to-one aliases are visible; counts are per declared pair, not a capability score.
frame_policy: Complete raw JSON-RPC response and CallToolResult byte identities are retained; identifiers, metadata, paths and formatting are not removed.
native_complete_evidence: Same live native controller was sampled before and after entry Provider operations. Compare actual complete bundle separately; original bundle contains its own explicitly different operation history.
negative_pairing: Only unmapped-address and flags extra-field have analogous recorded pairs. Other negative inputs are unpaired, not invented or silently coerced.
no_return_repair: Original C9 diagnostics directly report cleared=0 sites=0 refit=0 for this fixture. Native does not execute NoReturnFix. Other inputs remain open.
opaque_policy: Content text is compared as exact UTF-8 bytes separately. JSON decoding is only an additional explicitly named analysis layer.

statuses.DIFF: both fields are present and their typed values differ
statuses.MATCH: exact typed field equality under a declared pointer mapping
statuses.NATIVE_ONLY: no declared original counterpart in this captured comparison layer
statuses.ORIGINAL_ONLY: no declared native counterpart in this captured comparison layer
